caseNameFull: Helms, Individually, and as Next Friend of Helms, a Minor v. Picard, Superintendent of Louisiana Public Education and Picard, Superintendent of Louisiana Public Education v. Helms

opinions.text: C. A. 5th Cir. The Court reversed the judgment below in Mitchell v. Helms, ante, p. 793. Therefore, certiorari granted, and cases remanded for further proceedings. Reported below: 151 F. 3d 347 and 165 F..3d 311.
